mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the past month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5% and has risen by more than 0.2 percentage points over the past three months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS rise > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and an increase in non-farm payrolls signals a strengthening labor market that boosts corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales growth (RSAFS) exceeds 3% year-over-year, it signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS YoY growth exceeds 3%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past quarter indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO has increased over the past quarter, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 600,000 units per month, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer wealth and corporate revenue, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
